text: {"components": [{"type": "entity", "quote": "Conseil fédéral", "gist": "Swiss Federal Council"}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "groupe PLR aux Chambres fédérales", "gist": "PLR parliamentary group in the Swiss federal assembly"}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "commission de la sécurité sociale et de la santé publique du Conseil national", "gist": "National Council's commission for social security and public health"}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "Ignazio Cassis", "gist": "Ignazio Cassis"}, {"type": "date", "quote": "20 septembre 2017", "gist": "September 20, 2017"}, {"type": "date", "quote": "1er novembre 2017", "gist": "November 1, 2017"}, {"type": "date", "quote": "2022", "gist": "Year 2022"}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "Département fédéral des affaires étrangères (DFAE)", "gist": "Swiss Federal Department of Foreign Affairs"}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "Il a été président du groupe PLR aux Chambres fédérales et président de la commission de la sécurité sociale et de la santé publique du Conseil national.", "gist": "He was president of the PLR parliamentary group and of the National Council's social security and public health commission."}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "Ignazio Cassis est marié.", "gist": "Ignazio Cassis is married."}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "L'Assemblée fédérale a élu le libéral-radical Ignazio Cassis au Conseil fédéral.", "gist": "The Federal Assembly elected liberal-radical Ignazio Cassis to the Federal Council."}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "Depuis le 1er novembre 2017, il dirige le Département fédéral des affaires étrangères (DFAE).", "gist": "Since November 1, 2017, he has headed the Federal Department of Foreign Affairs."}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "En 2022, il a été président de la Confédération.", "gist": "In 2022, he served as President of the Confederation."}]}
